title: Flanged bushing

description.en: A flanged bushing turned about the Z axis: a flange of 30 mm diameter and 4 mm thick at the bottom (on the XY plane), then a body of 16 mm diameter up to an overall length of 24 mm, with a 10 mm bore all the way through. Make it as a revolution of its half section. Drive it by the variables flange_d, flange_t, body_d, length and bore_d.
description.nl: Een flensbus, gedraaid om de Z-as: onderaan (op het XY-vlak) een flens van 30 mm diameter en 4 mm dik, daarboven een lichaam van 16 mm diameter tot een totale lengte van 24 mm, met een boring van 10 mm helemaal door. Maak hem als omwenteling van zijn halve doorsnede. Stuur hem met de variabelen flange_d, flange_t, body_d, length en bore_d.

expect.value: pi * ((flange_d / 2)^2 - (bore_d / 2)^2) + pi * ((flange_d / 2)^2 - (body_d / 2)^2) + pi * ((body_d / 2)^2 - (bore_d / 2)^2) + 2 * pi * (flange_d / 2) * flange_t + 2 * pi * (body_d / 2) * (length - flange_t) + 2 * pi * (bore_d / 2) * length

value: pi * (((flange_d / 2)^2 - (bore_d / 2)^2) * flange_t^2 / 2 + ((body_d / 2)^2 - (bore_d / 2)^2) * (length - flange_t) * (length + flange_t) / 2) / (pi * (((flange_d / 2)^2 - (bore_d / 2)^2) * flange_t + ((body_d / 2)^2 - (bore_d / 2)^2) * (length - flange_t)))

derivation: Two tubes stacked on the axis: the flange, outer radius Rf, inner rb, height tf, and the body, outer Rb, inner rb, height L - tf.
Area: the bottom ring pi (Rf^2 - rb^2), the flange's top ring pi (Rf^2 - Rb^2), the top ring pi (Rb^2 - rb^2), and the walls 2 pi Rf tf, 2 pi Rb (L - tf), 2 pi rb L.
Centroid on the axis; its Z is the volume-weighted mean of the tubes' mid-heights tf/2 and (tf + L)/2.
